evidence.supporting_excerpt_or_summary: AWS documents a single SQL query path that accesses and combines memory and magnetic data without requiring the caller to select the tier.

evidence.title: Schedule expressions for scheduled queries
evidence.claim: Timestream scheduled queries support cron and rate expressions with one-minute minimum precision in UTC.
evidence.supporting_excerpt_or_summary: AWS documents schedule expression forms, UTC execution and minimum schedule precision.

evidence.title: Amazon Timestream API Reference
evidence.claim: Timestream exposes documented Write and Query APIs and management operations for time-series resources.
evidence.supporting_excerpt_or_summary: The official API reference covers Query, Write and service resource operations and data types.

evidence.title: VictoriaMetrics
evidence.claim: VictoriaMetrics is an Apache-2.0 open-source time-series database and monitoring backend.
evidence.supporting_excerpt_or_summary: The official repository documents VictoriaMetrics' time-series storage, query and cluster capabilities and Apache-2.0 license.

capabilities.notes: Managed time-series storage and decoupled ingestion/query architecture are documented.
Memory/magnetic tiers, retention, late data and upsert behavior are documented.
SQL query, scheduled query and API surfaces are documented; account-specific behavior was not tested.
VictoriaMetrics covers a self-hosted time-series foundation but not Timestream's IAM, serverless scaling, tier model, product split or managed AWS integrations.
